intro: San Jose rewards visitors with a walkable downtown, world-class tech museums, and easy access to hills and coast. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: VTA light rail links downtown, the airport area, and suburbs.
VTA buses cover the city; Clipper card or contactless pay works.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft operate widely.
Driving is easy but parking downtown costs money; rush hour is slow.
Downtown is walkable; bikes and scooters are common.
No ferry service in San Jose.

winchester.name: Winchester Mystery House
winchester.price_text: ≈ $40–50 per mansion tour; gardens and grounds free
winchester.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00; check tour times on the day
winchester.tip: Book a timed tour online and arrive 15 minutes early; the house is only seen with a guide.

rosicrucian.name: Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum
rosicrucian.tip: See the replica tomb in the basement and walk the peaceful gardens and planetarium next door.

sjma.name: San Jose Museum of Art
sjma.price_text: ≈ $10 adult; discounts for students and seniors
sjma.tip: Small and calm; pair it with the plaza and the nearby SoFA galleries.

happy-hollow.name: Happy Hollow Park and Zoo
happy-hollow.hours: Closed some weekdays; check the calendar on the day
happy-hollow.tip: Good for young kids; go early for the zoo and stay for the small rides.

rose-garden.name: San Jose Municipal Rose Garden
rose-garden.tip: Peak bloom is late spring; bring a picnic and walk the quiet paths.

great-america.name: California's Great America
great-america.price_text: ≈ $50–90 one-day ticket; buy online for less
great-america.hours: Seasonal; usually open daily in summer, weekends off-season
great-america.tip: Check the operating calendar first; arrive at opening for the big coasters.

scu.name: Santa Clara University
scu.hours: Grounds open daily; the mission church has limited hours
scu.tip: Visit the old Mission Santa Clara church and the shaded central lawn.

stanford.name: Stanford University
stanford.price_text: Free to walk; paid parking on campus
stanford.hours: Campus open daily; Memorial Church and Hoover Tower have set hours
stanford.tip: Climb Hoover Tower for the view and walk the Main Quad and Palm Drive.

golfland-milpitas.name: Golfland (Milpitas)
golfland-milpitas.price_text: ≈ $10–20 per round of mini-golf; arcade extra
golfland-milpitas.hours: Daily, usually late morning to late evening
golfland-milpitas.tip: Good rainy-day or evening option; check prices per course on arrival.

golfland-sanjose.name: Golfland (San Jose)
golfland-sanjose.price_text: ≈ $10–20 per round of mini-golf; arcade extra
golfland-sanjose.hours: Daily, usually late morning to late evening
golfland-sanjose.tip: Closest mini-golf to downtown; fine for a short family break.

golfland-sunnyvale.name: Golfland (Sunnyvale)
golfland-sunnyvale.price_text: ≈ $10–20 per round of mini-golf; arcade extra
golfland-sunnyvale.hours: Daily, usually late morning to late evening
golfland-sunnyvale.tip: Handy if you are already in the South Bay tech corridor.

san-pedro-market.name: San Pedro Square Market
san-pedro-market.price_text: ≈ $10–25 per person for food and drink
san-pedro-market.hours: Daily; stalls vary, busiest at lunch and evening
san-pedro-market.tip: Many small food stalls in one hall; good first stop to try local eats.

sofa-walk.name: SoFA District gallery walk
sofa-walk.price_text: Free to walk; galleries and events vary
sofa-walk.hours: Best in the afternoon and evening; check First Friday events
sofa-walk.tip: The arts district comes alive on First Friday evenings with open galleries.

santana-row.name: Santana Row stroll
santana-row.price_text: Free to walk; shops and restaurants extra
santana-row.tip: Outdoor shopping street with cafes; pleasant for an evening walk and dinner.

japantown.name: Japantown walk and eats
japantown.price_text: ≈ $10–25 per person for snacks and meals
japantown.hours: Shops and restaurants daily; some close on Mondays
japantown.tip: Small historic district; try a Japanese bakery and the grocery stores.

guadalupe-river.name: Guadalupe River Trail
guadalupe-river.tip: Flat paved path for a walk or bike ride; go in daylight.

city-hall-view.name: San Jose City Hall plaza and dome
city-hall-view.hours: Plaza open daily; building on weekdays
city-hall-view.tip: Quick photo stop for the glass dome; combine with a downtown walk.

history-park.name: History Park San Jose
history-park.hours: Usually Wed–Sun; check hours on the day
history-park.tip: Outdoor museum of old buildings and a trolley; relaxed for families.

tech-museum.name: The Tech Interactive
tech-museum.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00; check on the day
tech-museum.tip: Hands-on science and tech; best for kids and teens.

kelley-park.name: Kelley Park
kelley-park.tip: Green space next to History Park and Happy Hollow; good picnic stop.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum and the old downtown.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Farm-to-table dining, taquerias and the Japantown bakeries.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Alum Rock trails, the Guadalupe River path and nearby hills.

stays.why: Walk to museums, the convention center and the San Pedro Square food spots. Best base without a car.
Gallery and nightlife quarter south of downtown; close to the convention center and the arts scene.
Shops, restaurants and a lively evening scene; good for couples and shoppers, but you'll want a car or ride app.
Quiet, walkable and full of Japanese restaurants and markets; a short ride from downtown.

food: Try a Mission-style burrito or a plate of tacos at a taqueria; many are cheap and filling, roughly $10–15.
San Pedro Square Market downtown: many small stalls under one roof, good for groups and picky eaters.
Japantown for ramen, sushi and Japanese bakeries; walk the few blocks and pick what looks busy.
The area grows much of the region's produce; look for farm-to-table menus and weekend farmers' markets.
Book popular dinner spots ahead for Friday and Saturday; walk-ins can mean a long wait.
more_time: Add a day for the Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum and the rose garden next door; a calm, cheap half-day.
Nature lovers: swap an afternoon for a hike at Alum Rock Park in the eastern hills; go early in summer.
Have a car? Drive to the coast (Santa Cruz) or the hills for a half-day; check traffic before you go.
